For your collection it’s a waste of money and it is probably the worst least accurate app on the App Store. If you’re downloading this to keep track of what your cards are worth. You are gonna get scammed out of your money because of this app not from the app but because of it. The scanner doesn’t even work. There are far better apps than this one like DeckTradr. Seems to be accurate because it goes deeper than last.

reviews.title: Accuracy
reviews.text: As much as I like this app, the prices are INCREDIBLY inaccurate. I pulled a one piece card and it said it was worth $1765, but then I checked TCG player and the card is actually worth $250. Another card I pulled said it’s worth was $135, when TCG player says $41…..I need yall to make the prices just as accurate as TCG player.

reviews.title: Input/Output Doesn’t Work
reviews.text: Beware! The only format this app will import is TCGplayer CSV, but it only outputs its own proprietary format. The fact that it can’t even import the file it exports itself is beyond absurd and feels like malicious design to keep you locked into their app and unable to switch to another one. It’s essentially a lie to say that this app even has export functionality when that very export functionality is not compatible with anything, even the app’s own import functionality. I really wish I had known all of this before I took the time to add my entire collection into this app. I deeply regret choosing it.

reviews.title: Frustrating to Track Sealed
reviews.text:
I downloaded the app to track my sealed magic collection, which it was doing a wonderful job. That was until I tried to edit my quantities. 

I decided to open one of my products for my personal collection. The app saw this a loss to my overall portfolio, really screwing up the overall number values. I tried adding it as a “sold” product, still showed as a loss. This made NO sense to me. I reached out in their discord and spoke with a moderator who basically told me “That’s too bad bud, that’s not what our app is ment for”. 

I gave him a scenario about what if I scanned a product multiple times by mistake and didn’t want that to reflect a deficit on my portfolios worth. They said I would have to submit a ticket to have the problem fix if able. 

Needless to say I stopped scanning my collection on this app on that day. I since then have found another app that lets me change my inventory quantity without being penalized.
